sloka: दम्भुर्दैत्यमहाराजो वृत्रो बाणस्तथैव च ।राजर्षयः शास्त्रविदो गन्धर्वाः समहोरगाः ।। ७.२२.२६ ॥
transliteration: dambhurdaityamahārājo vṛtro bāṇastathaiva ca ।rājarṣayaḥ śāstravido gandharvāḥ samahoragāḥ ।। 7.22.26 ॥

translations.english: The glorious Hiranyakashipu, Namuchi, Shambara, Visandhi, Dhumaketu, and Bali Vairochana were among them.
